RagShortTexts: Coup d'état of Karthus, general of Jarmalius

Variants.Content: Who is Karthus? I don’t know. I heard that he was a general from the ancient empire. He seems to have staged a coup.

Karsus was a general in the ancient empire of Gyalmalus. He launched a coup in Gyalmalus and tried to seize power, but failed. Like most people in the Central Plains, he is extremely conservative and advocates force.
